name: delendai/heredoc-fix
description: Autonomous command/heredoc fixer shim. Fixes the recurring failure class where an agent command chain carries complex nesting that the exec frame mangles: backquotes, `<<'PY'` heredocs, nested `$()` / `(...)` inside single-quoted ssh/bash -c, `2>&1`. Rebuilds a de-nested single script, writes it to a temp file, runs it via a clean bash --noprofile env.

exit_codes.2: fixed + ran clean (a de-nest/fix was applied)
